summary: Iteration 4 — Orders lifecycle validation (Cancel/Return/Refund + tracking UI + Admin Returns). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_orders_lifecycle.py (12 pytest cases): all 12 PASS. Independently re-verified via UI on Vite frontend end-to-end. Full regression (39 tests across /app/tests/backend_test.py + /app/backend/tests/test_auth_new.py) also GREEN (39/39). No new backend or frontend defects found for this feature set. Note: the CRITICAL webhook bug from iteration_3 (payment webhook prisma middleware order) is unrelated to this iteration and still needs main-agent fix.
action_items: Carry-over from iteration_3 (NOT re-tested here): fix webhook prisma middleware ordering in /app/ecommerce-platform/server/index.js so req.prisma is attached before POST /api/payments/webhook.
critical_code_review_comments: orderRoutes.js correctly declares PATCH /:id/cancel and POST /:id/return BEFORE GET /:id — otherwise 'cancel'/'return' would be treated as an order id.
cancelOrder correctly gates by status ∈ {PENDING,CONFIRMED,PROCESSING} and returns 404 (not 403) for non-owner — good for preventing enumeration.
createReturnRequest correctly restricts to DELIVERED status, requires reason, and rejects duplicate open requests (verified: 400 on second call).

admin updateReturnRequest COMPLETED path is atomic across ReturnRequest.status, Order.status→REFUNDED, Payment.status→REFUNDED, inventory restock, and refundAmount default = order.total — all verified via GET checks after mutation.

OrderDetails.jsx correctly conditions cancel-order-btn on cancellable statuses and return-order-btn on DELIVERED; refund-badge only on REFUNDED. Timeline component highlights current status; CANCELLED/REFUNDED show banner instead.
AdminReturns page + sidebar link render properly; Approve→Complete&Refund actions dispatch PATCH /api/admin/returns/:id and refresh list.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids present, cancel/return/refund/admin flows verified in browser)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create a handful of TEST_ COD orders + a few DELIVERED orders + associated ReturnRequests (some COMPLETED → REFUNDED). Inventory net-zero for cancel tests (restock verified). UI test also performed 1 cancel + 1 return submission + 1 admin approve+complete on live data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order lifecycle feature is production-ready. Data testids on OrderDetails/AdminReturns are stable and reliable: order-tracking, order-status-badge, cancel-order-btn, return-order-btn, return-form, return-reason, return-submit, return-status, refund-badge, download-invoice-btn, admin-returns-page. Backend routes: PATCH /api/orders/:id/cancel, POST /api/orders/:id/return, GET/PATCH /api/admin/returns[/:id]. Full lifecycle: create COD order → admin PATCH /api/admin/orders/:id/status DELIVERED → user POST /return → admin PATCH /returns/:id APPROVED → admin PATCH /returns/:id COMPLETED (triggers order REFUNDED + payment REFUNDED + inventory +qty). Outstanding pre-existing bug: webhook prisma middleware (iteration_3).
